labs.location: Harvard Kennedy School, 79 John F. Kennedy Street, Cambridge, MA 02138
labs.research_summary: Kennedy School center that teaches and studies public leadership in government, politics, civil society and business, and funds leadership fellowships for students.
labs.notes: No lead is named on the pages read. The gathered people page (a Faculty filter on the cpl.hks.harvard.edu host) and the gathered Gergen Summer Fellowship page both return the home page text, so they show no roster or fellowship details. On www.hks.harvard.edu the filtered people views (Center Leadership, Staff, Faculty, Senior Fellows, Leadership Council) are blocked by robots.txt. The unfiltered Our Community directory (https://www.hks.harvard.edu/centers/cpl/people/search) runs five pages and mixes 48 faculty, 33 staff, 21 Leadership Council members, 6 Hauser Leaders, 3 senior fellows and 2 center leaders; only page 1 was read and it does not reach the center leaders, so no count. The menus list nine student fellowships (American Service, Emirates Leadership Initiative, Equity, George, David Gergen Summer, Gleitsman, David M. Rubenstein, Wolk Israel Graduate, Zuckerman), all for Harvard students; none was read, so no join page is recorded. No general email or phone appears on the pages read.
